name: Account Status 3 Code
definition: Qualifies further the current state of an account.

ENAB.name: Enabled
ENAB.definition: Account can be used for its intended purpose.

DISA.name: Disabled
DISA.definition: Account cannot be used for its intended purpose, either temporarily or permanently.

DELE.name: Deleted
DELE.definition: Account cannot be used any longer.

FORM.name: Pro Forma
FORM.definition: Account is temporary and can be partially used for its intended purpose. The account will be fully available for use when the account servicer has received all relevant documents.
